name: unblock
title: See what is stuck
description: Lists the open tasks, overdue ones first, and the handoffs that are waiting.
say: What is stuck that I must unblock?

steps.title: Rank what is stuck
steps.prompt: From these lists, say what is stuck and who or what each item is waiting on, overdue first. Tasks: {{steps.tasks.output.text}} Handoffs: {{steps.handoffs.output.text}} Then offer to close, defer or drop each one.
